notes.title: Escalar Available to Playtest now until June 9th!
notes.content:
Hey there! 

The first Steam demo of Escalar is now available to playtest, you can request access and join the playtest by heading onto the Escalar store page! The current playtest will be available to play from May 31st to June 9th! [b]Check it out now![/b] 👇


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321700/Escalar/


🎮 After you have completed the demo, it would be great if you could leave us [url=https://forms.gle/MZfwfdNzfGHn19qp8]feedback on our form![/url] All the feedback we receive helps us improve the game and make it more enjoyable for players!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44137028/549293a90c9378ca6a82047bc8d1ba8e35ad3ea7.png[/img]

[b]Haven't heard of Escalar before? Learn more about the game below[/b] 👇

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yvUlldzADls&feature=youtu.be

[i]✨ Escalar is a precision platformer experience where you have zero air control when you jump! As well as jumping, you'll also need to climb, grapple and avoid enemies that wander the tower!

✨ Make your way up a mysterious tower and explore environments filled with traps, hazards and gems! Along the way you'll encounter all sorts of characters, some with questionable motives... [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44137028/0c5c73107dbba25f0de9a7866075da1dee627cd6.png[/img]

[b]Previously played Escalar at events like EGX or WASD? Here's some of the main changes since then! [/b]👇
[list]
[*] There is now a specific key for climbing instead of jumping to climb.
[*] Grenade key no longer needs to held down, instead you press the key twice - once to equip and once to shoot the grenade.
[*] Tutorial signs that teach you game controls for mechanics!
[*] Pause Menu with Controls and a [b]reset to checkpoint[/b] if you get stuck anywhere!
[*] Grenade pickup to limit the number of grenades you can carry (displayed under the Gem Counter)
[*] Removed Charge Jump upgrade from Burlar's Bazaar
[*] New climbable vines added to replace previous climbing wall.
[*] Floating enemies added to the last level of the demo.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44137028/f965d4059f59cf64ee75ab7532ca642ef93ee426.png[/img]

Thanks for reading and we hope you enjoyed playing the demo!! We'll have lots more to share on [b]Escalar [/b]soon! In the meanwhile you can check out [url=https://linktr.ee/skylinestudiosgames]our socials[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/hYsvHBhAtP]Discord server[/url] (not quite launched yet, but we're accepting users!) 

- Chelsea
